compatibilityAtlas.purpose: retain current game compatibility and fallback validation while production-master-v3 is migrated

productionMasterV3.reason: A 160-pixel native cell gives the giant Frames enough screen presence, silhouette room and attack extension at 640x360 without baking effects into the body. A 256-slot atlas keeps the runtime regular while retaining 32 future/reserved slots.

recommendedHoldLanguage.principle: unique-cel count and simulation ticks are different; most drawings are held for 2-6 ticks, with deliberate longer holds on impact, recovery and mechanical settle

heavy-held.note: Bastion prioritises readable load and long recovery rather than extra in-betweens

fast-snap.note: Viper changes drawings quickly but still holds hero contact and brake poses

measured-brace.note: Citadel uses longer setup and containment holds rather than smooth motion

precise-drift.note: Mirage keeps body timing exact while optical echoes are timed independently

productionRules: one unique body cel per work unit; never ask a provider for a final packed atlas
final native body art is hand-mastered at 160x160 with real alpha and no baked antialiasing
the 640x640 authoring canvas is a structural working surface, not a direct automatic downscale target
body animation must remain readable without FX in one-colour silhouette
combat FX, muzzle/energy arcs, phase echoes, steam, sparks and screen fields remain separate
all grounded cels use the same 80,152 pivot and declared ground contacts
no body pixel may cross the four-pixel transparent safety boundary
walk-forward and walk-back are independently authored because mechanical load transfer is directional
standing and crouching guards have separate body states
high block, low block, instant block, guard crush, light hit, heavy hit and counter stagger are not interchangeable
reversal owns its own body bank in production-master-v3
Overdrive Pilot cut-ins do not replace the fourteen-cel Frame body sequence
reserved slots remain empty until a game-authoritative requirement exists
final promotion requires a matching steel-dominion production-v3 manifest, complete runtime evidence and named human approval
